pages.title: Kugelblitz Seed
pages.text: Enough energy concentrated in one place that it collapses into a black hole under its own gravity. Energy curves spacetime just as mass does, so even pure light, focused tightly enough, falls inward. The seed hums with heat, and I never point it toward anything I value.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Kugelblitz Chamber I annihilated antimatter against strange matter inside a shell of dark matter, so none of the energy escaped. Focused enough, it stopped being light and became a horizon waiting to form.
